       / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DOCType = 'Elementary School District' THEN DOC END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Orange'
  AND StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND DOCType IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District');

END AS lowest_grade

WHERE NCESDist = '0632640'

WITH school_scores AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        ss.NumGE1500,
        s.AdmEmail1,
        s.AdmEmail2,
        s.AdmEmail3
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS ss
        ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
      AND s.School IS NOT NULL
      AND ss.rtype = 'S'
),
max_score AS (
    SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) AS NumGE1500
    FROM school_scores
)
SELECT
    school_scores.School,
    school_scores.AdmEmail1,
    school_scores.AdmEmail2,
    school_scores.AdmEmail3
FROM school_scores
JOIN max_score
    ON school_scores.NumGE1500 = max_score.NumGE1500;

WITH middle_schools AS (
    SELECT SOCType AS school_type, School AS school_name, Latitude AS latitude
    FROM schools
    WHERE (
        LOWER(COALESCE(SOCType, '')) LIKE '%middle%'
        OR LOWER(COALESCE(SOCType, '')) LIKE '%junior%'
        OR LOWER(COALESCE(School, '')) LIKE '%middle%'
    )
      AND Latitude IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    school_type AS "School Type",
    school_name AS "School Name",
    latitude AS Latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE latitude = (SELECT MAX(latitude) FROM middle_schools);

WITH active_charters AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, FundingType
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
      AND FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
frpm_2014_2015 AS (
    SELECT
        CDSCode,
        `Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment,
        `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS frpm_percentage
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
),
school_sat AS (
    SELECT
        cds AS CDSCode,
        AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS combined_sat
    FROM satscores
    WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    a.FundingType,
    COUNT(*) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(f.enrollment) AS total_k12_enrollment,
    ROUND(AVG(f.frpm_percentage) * 100, 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(s.combined_sat), 2) AS avg_combined_sat_score
FROM active_charters AS a
LEFT JOIN frpm_2014_2015 AS f ON f.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN school_sat AS s ON s.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
GROUP BY a.FundingType;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'

  AND CAST(

  AND CAST(

          ELSE s.GSserved
        END AS INTEGER
      ) BETWEEN 1 AND 12

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_zero_takers
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.EILName = 'High School'
  AND s.DOCType IN (

      'High School District',
      'Unified School District',
      'State Board of Education',
      'Statewide Benefit Charter',
      'State Special Schools'
  )

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sc.Virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM satscores AS ss
JOIN schools AS sc ON sc.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE sc.State = 'CA'
  AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.GSserved,
        s.Charter,
        f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS free_meal_rate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
      AND (s.GSserved LIKE '%12%' OR s.GSserved = '12')
      AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
),
top_rate AS (
    SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS rate
    FROM eligible_schools
)
SELECT
    e.School AS school_name,
    printf('%.4f', e.free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE e.Charter
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_school,
    e.GSserved AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN ss.AvgScrRead IS NULL
          OR ss.AvgScrMath IS NULL
          OR ss.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level
FROM eligible_schools AS e
JOIN top_rate AS t ON e.free_meal_rate = t.rate
LEFT JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = e.CDSCode;

WITH top_score AS (
    SELECT MAX(sat.AvgScrMath) AS highest_math
    FROM satscores AS sat
    JOIN schools AS active_school
      ON active_school.CDSCode = sat.cds
    WHERE active_school.StatusType = 'Active'
      AND sat.NumTstTakr >= 10
)
SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Phone AS phone_number,
    s.Website AS website,
    sat.AvgScrRead AS average_sat_reading,
    sat.AvgScrMath AS average_sat_math,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS average_sat_writing,
    s.Charter AS charter_school,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12_2014_2015,
    ROUND(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`, 2) AS percent_students_eligible_frpm,
    t.highest_math AS highest_active_school_sat_math,
    t.highest_math - sat.AvgScrMath AS points_below_highest_math
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
 AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
CROSS JOIN top_score AS t
WHERE s.CDSCode = '07618040113118';

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr >= 700
ORDER BY 1.0 * t.NumGE1500 / t.NumTstTakr ASC,
         CAST(t.cds AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10;

WITH qualifying_sets AS (
    SELECT s.code
    FROM sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
        ON st.setCode = s.code
    GROUP BY s.code
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT st.translation) < 5
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards
    GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT SUM(card_counts.card_count) AS total_cards
FROM qualifying_sets
JOIN card_counts
    ON card_counts.setCode = qualifying_sets.code;

SELECT
    s.type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN st.translation IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(st.translation) <> '' THEN s.id
    END) AS sets_with_translated_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN st.translation IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(st.translation) <> '' THEN c.id
    END) AS total_cards
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
LEFT JOIN cards AS c
    ON c.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings AS r
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
  AND r.date = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.date)
    FROM rulings AS r2
    JOIN cards AS c2 ON c2.uuid = r2.uuid
    WHERE c2.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
  );

SELECT c.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.frameVersion = (
    SELECT MAX(frameVersion)
    FROM cards
    WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
)
GROUP BY c.frameVersion;

WITH printing_counts AS (
    SELECT
        frameVersion,
        COUNT(*) AS printing_count,
        COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS percentage
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
    GROUP BY frameVersion
)
SELECT
    frameVersion AS year,
    ROUND(percentage, 2) AS percentage
FROM printing_counts
ORDER BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH numbered_abzan AS (
    SELECT
        c.name,
        c.number,
        c.uuid,
        c.setCode,
        CAST(c.number AS INTEGER) AS collector_number,
        MAX(CAST(c.number AS INTEGER)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.setCode) AS set_max_number
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE lower(c.watermark) = 'abzan'
)
SELECT
    a.name,
    a.number AS collector_number,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM foreign_data AS fd
        WHERE fd.uuid = a.uuid
    ) AS foreign_language_printings
FROM numbered_abzan AS a
WHERE a.collector_number = a.set_max_number;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations st
      WHERE st.setCode = s.code
        AND st.language <> 'English'
        AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE duelDeck = 'b'
  AND hasFoil = 0
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

WITH unique_cards AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT scryfallOracleId, name, artist
    FROM cards
    WHERE borderColor = 'black'
      AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
      AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
),
artist_counts AS (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM unique_cards
    GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT artist, card_count
FROM artist_counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM artist_counts)
ORDER BY artist;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist)
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
  AND availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(power) <> ''
  AND power NOT LIKE '%*%'
  AND power NOT LIKE '%+%'
  AND power NOT LIKE '%−%'
  AND power NOT LIKE '%-%'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) >= 5
  AND artist IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(artist) <> '';

SELECT frameVersion AS frame_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(scryfallOracleId, name)) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE instr(leadershipSkills, "'commander': True") > 0
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId <> ''
  AND frameVersion IS NOT NULL
  AND frameVersion <> ''
GROUP BY frameVersion
ORDER BY CASE
           WHEN frameVersion = 'future' THEN 1
           ELSE CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)
         END DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS ruling_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) = (
    SELECT MAX(ruling_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r2.id) AS ruling_count
        FROM cards AS c2
        JOIN rulings AS r2 ON r2.uuid = c2.uuid
        WHERE c2.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
        GROUP BY c2.name
    )
);

SELECT cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM (
    SELECT name, cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
    FROM (
        SELECT name, cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY name
                   ORDER BY CAST(cardKingdomFoilId AS INTEGER), cardKingdomId
               ) AS rn
        FROM cards
        WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
          AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
          AND cardKingdomFoilId <> ''
          AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
          AND cardKingdomId <> ''
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
    ORDER BY CAST(cardKingdomFoilId AS INTEGER), cardKingdomId
    LIMIT 3
)
ORDER BY name ASC, cardKingdomId ASC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId)
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion IN ('2015', 'future')
  AND text IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(text) <> '';

SELECT ROUND(
    COUNT(st.language) * 1.0 /
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.code),
    2
)
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01';

WITH block_sets AS (
    SELECT
        s.block,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN st.translation IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(st.translation) <> '' THEN s.code
        END) AS sets_with_official_translated_name,
        SUM(s.baseSetSize) AS total_base_set_cards
    FROM sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
        ON st.setCode = s.code
    WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
      AND s.type = 'expansion'
    GROUP BY s.block
)
SELECT
    block AS block_name,
    sets_with_official_translated_name,
    total_base_set_cards
FROM block_sets
ORDER BY CASE block WHEN 'Masques' THEN 1 WHEN 'Mirage' THEN 2 END;

WITH first_posts AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId, MIN(CreaionDate) AS first_post_date
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
      AND CreaionDate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM first_posts AS fp
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = fp.OwnerUserId
WHERE fp.first_post_date >= '2010-01-01'
  AND fp.first_post_date < '2011-01-01'
  AND TRIM(u.Location) = 'India';

WITH badge_totals AS (
    SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_total
    FROM users AS u
    LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location = 'Germany'
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
),
ranked_totals AS (
    SELECT badge_total,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY badge_total DESC) AS total_rank
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT badge_total FROM badge_totals)
)
SELECT bt.DisplayName, bt.badge_total
FROM badge_totals AS bt
JOIN ranked_totals AS rt ON rt.badge_total = bt.badge_total
WHERE rt.total_rank = 2
ORDER BY bt.DisplayName;

SELECT Id
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName = 'Michael'
ORDER BY CreationDate DESC, Id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Reputation < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
  AND p.Score > 5;

SELECT c.Segment, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date >= '201301'
  AND y.Date < '201401'
GROUP BY c.Segment;

SELECT CAST((julianday(MAX(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time)) - julianday(MIN(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time))) * 24 * 60 AS INTEGER) AS elapsed_minutes
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Price > 1000;

WITH quarterly AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Consumption) AS quarter_consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date IN ('201304', '201305', '201306')
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT
    c.Currency,
    ROUND(AVG(q.quarter_consumption), 2) AS avg_quarter_consumption
FROM quarterly q
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK')
GROUP BY c.Currency
ORDER BY c.Currency;

SELECT p.player_api_id, AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS mean_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
  ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
  AND pa.heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.player_api_id
ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_3
WHERE p.height > 180;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        defensive_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(defensive_work_rate) <> ''
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked AS r
    ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
   AND r.rn = 1
WHERE p.birthday >= '1990-01-01'
  AND p.birthday < '1996-01-01'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(r.defensive_work_rate)) = 'medium'
  AND p.height IS NOT NULL;

WITH player_totals AS (
    SELECT home_player_3 AS player_id, SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_goals
    FROM "Match"
    WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY home_player_3
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_goals), 2) AS average_home_goals
FROM player_totals;

WITH ranked_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        preferred_foot,
        attacking_work_rate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_api_id
            ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN attacking_work_rate = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM ranked_attributes
WHERE rn = 1
  AND preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(attacking_work_rate) <> '';

WITH salary_range AS (
    SELECT MAX(A12) - MIN(A12) AS salary_difference
    FROM district
),
oldest_female AS (
    SELECT c.client_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.district_id = (
          SELECT district_id
          FROM district
          WHERE A12 = (SELECT MIN(A12) FROM district)
      )
      AND c.birth_date = (
          SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date)
          FROM client c2
          WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
            AND c2.district_id = (
                SELECT district_id
                FROM district
                WHERE A12 = (SELECT MIN(A12) FROM district)
            )
      )
)
SELECT dp.account_id, sr.salary_difference
FROM oldest_female ofe
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = ofe.client_id
CROSS JOIN salary_range sr;

WITH first_month AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) AS month
    FROM account
),
opened_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN first_month AS f
      ON strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = f.month
),
district_populations AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN opened_districts AS o
      ON o.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT district_id, population
FROM district_populations
WHERE population = (SELECT MAX(population) FROM district_populations);

WITH top5 AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
district_load AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
            / COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id),
            0
        ) AS avg_active_loan_per_account
    FROM top5 t
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = t.district_id
    JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id
)
SELECT district_name, avg_active_loan_per_account
FROM district_load
WHERE avg_active_loan_per_account = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_active_loan_per_account) FROM district_load
);

WITH regional_totals AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS region, SUM(l.amount) AS total_approved_amount
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE l.date <= '1995-12-31'
      AND date(l.date, '+' || l.duration || ' months', '-1 day') >= '1995-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.A2
)
SELECT region, total_approved_amount
FROM regional_totals
WHERE total_approved_amount = (
    SELECT MAX(total_approved_amount)
    FROM regional_totals
);

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT dp.account_id, c.gender
    FROM card ca
    JOIN disp dp
      ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
     AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c
      ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
),
average_balances AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
gender_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ea.gender, a.district_id
    FROM eligible_accounts ea
    JOIN average_balances ab
      ON ab.account_id = ea.account_id
     AND ab.avg_balance > 1000
    JOIN account a
      ON a.account_id = ea.account_id
    JOIN district d
      ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) > 100000
),
district_metrics AS (
    SELECT gd.gender,
           gd.district_id,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
           d.A11 AS salary,
           d.A13 AS urban_ratio
    FROM gender_districts gd
    JOIN district d
      ON d.district_id = gd.district_id
),
summaries AS (
    SELECT gender,
           COUNT(*) AS district_count,
           MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants,
           ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
    FROM district_metrics
    GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT s.gender,
       s.district_count,
       dm.district_id,
       dm.inhabitants,
       s.avg_salary,
       s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM summaries s
JOIN district_metrics dm
  ON dm.gender = s.gender
 AND dm.inhabitants = s.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE s.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END,
         dm.district_id;

WITH qualified_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp own
      ON own.client_id = c.client_id
     AND own.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card ca
          WHERE ca.disp_id = own.disp_id
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM loan l
          WHERE l.account_id = own.account_id
      )
),
regional_districts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region,
           d.A2 AS district_name,
           d.A11 AS salary,
           d.A12 AS unemployment_1996,
           d.A16 AS inhabitants
    FROM district d
    JOIN qualified_districts q
      ON q.district_id = d.district_id
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT region,
           district_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY region
               ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM regional_districts
)
SELECT rd.region,
       ROUND(AVG(rd.salary), 2) AS average_district_salary,
       ROUND(AVG(rd.unemployment_1996), 2) AS average_1996_unemployment_rate,
       MAX(CASE WHEN ranked.rn = 1 THEN ranked.district_name END) AS most_populous_district
FROM regional_districts rd
JOIN ranked_districts ranked
  ON ranked.region = rd.region
 AND ranked.district_name = rd.district_name
GROUP BY rd.region;

WITH district_crimes AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region_name,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS crime_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a
        ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = a.account_id
       AND t.date >= '1996-01-01'
       AND t.date < '1997-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4
),
ranked_central_boh AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, lower(district_name) COLLATE NOCASE ASC
        ) AS population_rank
    FROM district_crimes
    WHERE region_name = 'central Bohemia'
),
top_three AS (
    SELECT
        dc.district_id,
        dc.district_name,
        dc.crime_count,
        rb.population_rank
    FROM district_crimes AS dc
    JOIN ranked_central_boh AS rb
      ON rb.district_id = dc.district_id
    WHERE rb.population_rank <= 3
),
averages AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(crime_count) AS overall_average
    FROM district_crimes
)
SELECT
    t.district_name,
    t.crime_count,
    ROUND(AVG(t.crime_count) OVER (), 2) AS three_district_average,
    ROUND(a.overall_average, 2) AS overall_average,
    ROUND(AVG(t.crime_count) OVER () - a.overall_average, 2) AS difference
FROM top_three AS t
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
ORDER BY t.population_rank;

WITH region_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A3 = (SELECT A3 FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice')
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
),
ranked_transactions AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           t.balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY t.account_id
               ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN region_accounts AS ra ON ra.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date < '1997-01-01'
),
last_balances AS (
    SELECT account_id, balance
    FROM ranked_transactions
    WHERE rn = 1
),
account_balances AS (
    SELECT ra.account_id, ra.district_id, lb.balance
    FROM region_accounts AS ra
    LEFT JOIN last_balances AS lb ON lb.account_id = ra.account_id
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
           COUNT(ab.account_id) AS account_count,
           ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS average_balance
    FROM account_balances AS ab
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_average_balance
    FROM account_balances
),
top_district AS (
    SELECT district_name
    FROM district_stats
    ORDER BY average_balance DESC, district_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'district' AS result_type,
       district_name,
       account_count,
       average_balance,
       NULL AS region_average_balance,
       NULL AS highest_average_district
FROM district_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 'region_average', NULL, NULL, NULL, region_average_balance, NULL
FROM region_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 'highest_average_district', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, district_name
FROM top_district
ORDER BY result_type, district_name;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
top_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM ranked_loans AS r
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = r.account_id
    WHERE r.rn <= 10
),
district_summary AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        d.A11 AS average_salary
    FROM top_districts AS td
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = td.district_id
)
SELECT
    (
        SELECT district_id
        FROM district_summary
        ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS district_id,
    (
        SELECT inhabitants
        FROM district_summary
        ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS inhabitants,
    ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM district_summary;

WITH
client_home AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
accessible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
region_client_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        A3 AS region,
        A2 AS district_name,
        A4 AS inhabitants,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC) AS population_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC, district_id) AS most_populous_row
    FROM district
)
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS account_opened_date,
    a.frequency,
    account_district.A2 AS district_name,
    account_district.A3 AS region,
    CASE WHEN account_district.district_id = ch.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_client_home_district,
    account_district.A11 AS average_salary,
    COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
    COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
    COALESCE(tt.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
    rcc.client_count AS clients_in_region,
    most_populous.district_name AS most_populous_district,
    most_populous.inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
    account_rank.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM accessible_accounts aa
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = aa.account_id
JOIN district account_district ON account_district.district_id = a.district_id
CROSS JOIN client_home ch
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals tt ON tt.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_client_counts rcc ON rcc.region = account_district.A3
LEFT JOIN ranked_districts account_rank ON account_rank.district_id = account_district.district_id
LEFT JOIN ranked_districts most_populous
    ON most_populous.region = account_district.A3
   AND most_populous.most_populous_row = 1
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, a.account_id ASC;

WITH per_account AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        strftime('%Y', a.date) AS year,
        COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS lent
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, strftime('%Y', a.date)
),
per_district AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        district_id,
        AVG(lent) AS avg_lent_per_account
    FROM per_account
    GROUP BY year, district_id
)
SELECT
    p.year,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    SUM(p.lent) AS total_amount_lent,
    ROUND(AVG(d.avg_lent_per_account), 2) AS avg_district_amount_lent_per_account
FROM per_account AS p
JOIN per_district AS d
    ON d.year = p.year
   AND d.district_id = p.district_id
GROUP BY p.year
ORDER BY p.year;

SELECT d.A2 AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Moravia'
  AND t.date <= '1998-10-14'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NULL
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT t.bank AS bank_code,
       t.account AS account_number,
       COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
FROM loan AS l
JOIN trans AS t
  ON t.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < '1996-01-03'
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

WITH qualifying_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, a.district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 24
      AND l.date < '1997-01-01'
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population
    FROM qualifying_loans AS q
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = q.district_id
),
region_population AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        COUNT(*) AS district_count,
        SUM(population) AS combined_population
    FROM qualifying_districts
    GROUP BY region
),
region_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM qualifying_loans AS q
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = q.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT
    p.region,
    p.district_count,
    p.combined_population,
    a.account_count
FROM region_population AS p
JOIN region_accounts AS a ON a.region = p.region
ORDER BY p.combined_population DESC, p.region ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH classic_owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.client_id,
        d.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS c
        ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'classic'
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT
        coa.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT coa.client_id) AS client_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ'
             AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
             AND t.account IS NOT NULL
            THEN t.bank || ':' || CAST(t.account AS TEXT)
        END) AS external_account_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS payment_total
    FROM classic_owner_accounts AS coa
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = coa.account_id
    GROUP BY coa.district_id
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COALESCE(ds.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
    COALESCE(ds.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
    COALESCE(ds.payment_total, 0) AS payment_total
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN district_stats AS ds
    ON ds.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY payment_total DESC, district_name ASC;

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS score
FROM races r
JOIN constructorResults cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH hosted_2000 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT circuitId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2000
),
race_stops AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, COUNT(p.stop) AS pit_stops
    FROM races AS r
    LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND r.circuitId NOT IN (SELECT circuitId FROM hosted_2000)
    GROUP BY r.raceId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stops), 2) AS average_pit_stops
FROM race_stops;

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(*) AS runners_up_count
FROM results AS r
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND r.position = 2
GROUP BY d.forename
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY runners_up_count DESC, d.forename ASC;

SELECT d.driverRef, SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r
  ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lapTimes AS l
    WHERE l.driverId = r.driverId
      AND l.raceId = r.raceId
  )
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.driverRef
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH season_points AS (
    SELECT
        cr.constructorId,
        r.year,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.points, 0)) AS points
    FROM constructorResults AS cr
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
    GROUP BY cr.constructorId, r.year
),
career AS (
    SELECT
        c.constructorId,
        c.name,
        c.url,
        COALESCE(SUM(sp.points), 0) AS career_points
    FROM constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN season_points AS sp ON sp.constructorId = c.constructorId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        name,
        career_points,
        url,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS career_rank
    FROM career
)
SELECT
    name,
    career_points,
    url
FROM ranked
WHERE career_rank <= 3
ORDER BY career_points DESC, name;

SELECT
    r.year AS season_year,
    (runner_up.milliseconds - winner.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS runner_up_time_gap_seconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS winner
    ON winner.raceId = r.raceId
   AND winner.positionOrder = 1
JOIN results AS runner_up
    ON runner_up.raceId = r.raceId
   AND runner_up.positionOrder = 2
WHERE r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
  AND r.time = (
      SELECT MIN(time)
      FROM races
      WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
        AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
        AND time IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY r.year DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 IS NULL
ORDER BY q.q1 DESC, q.driverId;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE
        WHEN s.status = 'Finished' OR s.status LIKE '+% lap%' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1957
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = b.link_to_event
    WHERE LOWER(b.category) = 'advertising'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
);

WITH attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT
        m.member_id,
        m.position,
        COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS events_attended
    FROM member AS m
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')
            THEN 'officer'
        ELSE 'other student'
    END AS group_name,
    ROUND(AVG(events_attended), 2) AS average_events_attended
FROM attendance_counts
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')
            THEN 'officer'
        ELSE 'other student'
    END;

SELECT e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT x.expense_description) AS things_bought
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b
  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
 AND b.amount > 40
JOIN expense AS x
  ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY e.location;

SELECT
    x.expense_description AS item_name,
    b.category AS budget_category,
    SUM(x.cost) AS total_cost
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense AS x
    ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND x.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY b.category, x.expense_description
ORDER BY b.category, x.expense_description;

SELECT
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    (SELECT SUM(b.amount)
     FROM budget AS b
     WHERE b.link_to_event = e.event_id) AS total_amount_budgeted,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member)
     FROM attendance AS a
     WHERE a.link_to_event = e.event_id) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
ORDER BY e.event_name ASC, e.event_date ASC;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS times_bought
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY e.expense_description;

SELECT
    colour,
    hero_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hero_count DESC) AS rank
FROM (
    SELECT c.colour AS colour, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
    JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
      AND c.colour IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(c.colour) <> ''
    GROUP BY c.colour
)
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, colour ASC;

SELECT
    p.publisher_name,
    COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count,
    COUNT(s.id) - MIN(COUNT(s.id)) OVER () AS more_by
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics')
GROUP BY p.publisher_name
ORDER BY superhero_count DESC;

WITH publisher_counts AS (
    SELECT p.publisher_name, COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count
    FROM publisher AS p
    LEFT JOIN superhero AS s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
    GROUP BY p.id, p.publisher_name
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN superhero_count END) AS dc_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN superhero_count END) AS marvel_count
    FROM publisher_counts
)
SELECT CASE
    WHEN dc_count = marvel_count THEN 'Tie'
    WHEN dc_count > marvel_count THEN 'DC Comics by ' || (dc_count - marvel_count)
    ELSE 'Marvel Comics by ' || (marvel_count - dc_count)
END AS result
FROM comparison;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT ha2.attribute_value
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      JOIN superhero AS ab ON ab.id = ha2.hero_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
        AND ab.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
  )
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS INTEGER)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT hulk_ha.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS hulk
      JOIN hero_attribute AS hulk_ha ON hulk_ha.hero_id = hulk.id
      JOIN attribute AS hulk_a ON hulk_a.id = hulk_ha.attribute_id
      WHERE hulk.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
        AND hulk_a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
AND race_id IS NULL;

WITH marvel_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE publisher_id = 13
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.publisher_id = 4
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM marvel_eye_colours AS m
      WHERE m.eye_colour_id = s.eye_colour_id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1)
FROM superhero
WHERE race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb')
  AND height_cm IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg)
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM superhero AS f
      JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = f.gender_id
      WHERE f.race_id IS s.race_id
        AND LOWER(g.gender) = 'female'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS publisher_count
FROM publisher AS p
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm > 200;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH power_counts AS (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT
    g.gender,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(pc.power_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_superpowers_per_hero
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN power_counts AS pc ON pc.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND s.full_name <> '-'
  AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
GROUP BY g.gender;

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 2) AS average_height_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero
WHERE alignment_id = (SELECT id FROM alignment WHERE alignment = 'Bad')
  AND skin_colour_id = (SELECT id FROM colour WHERE colour = 'Green');

SELECT ROUND(AVG(h.height_cm), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS h
WHERE h.id <> (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
  AND h.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = h.id
        AND hp.power_id IN (
            SELECT hp3.power_id
            FROM hero_power AS hp3
            JOIN superhero AS h3 ON h3.id = hp3.hero_id
            WHERE h3.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
        )
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT MAX(power_count)
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE s.weight_kg = (
        SELECT MIN(weight_kg)
        FROM superhero
        WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY s.id
);

SELECT ec.colour AS eye_colour, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS hc ON hc.id = s.hair_colour_id
JOIN colour AS ec ON ec.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE hc.colour <> 'Brown'
  AND s.eye_colour_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT sh.eye_colour_id
      FROM superhero AS sh
      JOIN colour AS bh ON bh.id = sh.hair_colour_id
      WHERE bh.colour = 'Brown'
  )
GROUP BY s.eye_colour_id
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.id <> (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN hero_power AS ref ON ref.power_id = hp.power_id
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND ref.hero_id = (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
  );

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 END)
    - COUNT(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 END)
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND l.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
),
patient_titers AS (
    SELECT l.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER)) AS anti_rnp_titer
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT ID, anti_rnp_titer
FROM patient_titers
WHERE anti_rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_titer) FROM patient_titers)
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT
    CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END AS care_setting,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 16
)
GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END
ORDER BY care_setting DESC;

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE replace(replace(trim(Diagnosis), ' ', ''), ',', '') IN ('RASJS', 'SJSRA')
),
patient_status AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Laboratory AS l
            WHERE l.ID = p.ID
              AND l.PLT > 100
              AND l.PLT < 400
        ) AS has_normal_platelet
    FROM eligible_patients AS p
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT has_normal_platelet THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_never_normal_platelet
FROM patient_status;

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 32
)
SELECT
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT MIN(
    CAST(substr(L.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CAST(substr(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
) AS youngest_age
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(L.RNP AS NUMERIC) >= 64
  AND L.Date IS NOT NULL
  AND P.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS E
      WHERE E.ID = P.ID
        AND E.Thrombosis > 0
  );

WITH thrombosis_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis > 0
),
patient_first_exam AS (
    SELECT e.ID, MIN(e."Examination Date") AS first_exam_date
    FROM Examination e
    GROUP BY e.ID
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(pfe.first_exam_date) - julianday(p."First Date"))) AS average_delay_days
FROM Patient p
JOIN thrombosis_cohort tc ON tc.ID = p.ID
JOIN patient_first_exam pfe ON pfe.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission LIKE '%+%'
  AND p."First Date" IS NOT NULL
  AND pfe.first_exam_date IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.Admission, l.`T-CHO`, l.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND l.`T-CHO` = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.`T-CHO`)
    FROM Patient AS p2
    JOIN Laboratory AS l2 ON l2.ID = p2.ID
    WHERE p2.Admission = p.Admission
  )
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, l.ID;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'Hospital'
        WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 'Outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE CASE
          WHEN "U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST("U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 30
          WHEN "U-PRO" LIKE '+%' THEN CAST(substr("U-PRO", instr("U-PRO", '(') + 1) AS INTEGER) >= 30
          WHEN "U-PRO" LIKE '>=%' THEN CAST(substr("U-PRO", 3) AS INTEGER) >= 30
          ELSE 0
      END
  )
GROUP BY Admission;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%'
  AND p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.RF IN ('-', '+-')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')
  );

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', '0')
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('negative', 'none')
);

SELECT
    CASE p.Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS patient_group,
    COUNT(l.LDH) AS normal_lactate_dehydrogenase_measurements
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND (
      p.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%'
      OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%BEHCET%'
      OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%throm%'
  )
  AND l.LDH < 500
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 16
    GROUP BY ID
),
abnormal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT >= 60
),
gpt AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS max_gpt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT IS NOT NULL
      AND GPT < 60
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN gpt AS g ON g.ID = e.ID
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
LEFT JOIN abnormal AS a ON a.ID = e.ID
WHERE a.ID IS NULL
ORDER BY g.max_gpt DESC, p.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.PT < 14
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16
  );

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        CASE Admission
            WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
            WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
        END AS care_setting
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
      AND Birthday IS NOT NULL
      AND date(Birthday, '+50 years') <= '2026-10-09'
      AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
patient_results AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.care_setting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_elevated_result
    FROM eligible_patients AS p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.care_setting
)
SELECT
    care_setting,
    SUM(has_elevated_result) AS patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated_result = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_no_such_result
FROM patient_results
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

WITH ranked_labs AS (
    SELECT ID,
           IGG,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN ranked_labs AS l
    ON l.ID = p.ID
   AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.IGG >= 2000;

WITH latest_igg AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.IGG
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS l2
        WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
    )
)
SELECT
    CASE p.Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN latest_igg.IGG > 900 AND latest_igg.IGG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS p
LEFT JOIN latest_igg ON latest_igg.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY p.Admission
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.RNP,
        l.CPK,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY l.ID
            ORDER BY l.Date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
)
WHERE rn = 1
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 64
  AND CPK < 250;

SELECT ROUND(AVG((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425), 1)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 < 70
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 64
  );

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS occurrences
FROM atom
JOIN molecule USING (molecule_id)
WHERE label = '-'
GROUP BY element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(occurrences)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS occurrences
        FROM atom
        JOIN molecule USING (molecule_id)
        WHERE label = '-'
        GROUP BY element
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
  AND a1.element = 'c'
  AND a2.element = 'c';

WITH plus_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
bonded_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
),
element_counts AS (
    SELECT
        pa.element,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ba.atom_id IS NOT NULL THEN pa.atom_id END) AS bonded_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pa.atom_id) AS all_atom_count
    FROM plus_atoms AS pa
    LEFT JOIN bonded_atoms AS ba ON ba.atom_id = pa.atom_id
    GROUP BY pa.element
),
ranked_counts AS (
    SELECT
        element,
        bonded_count,
        MAX(bonded_count) OVER () AS max_bonded_count,
        SUM(all_atom_count) OVER () AS total_atoms
    FROM element_counts
)
SELECT
    element,
    ROUND(100.0 * bonded_count / total_atoms, 2) AS percentage_of_all_plus_atoms
FROM ranked_counts
WHERE bonded_count = max_bonded_count
ORDER BY element;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND (
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM atom AS other
      WHERE other.element = a1.element
        AND other.molecule_id <> b.molecule_id
    )
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM atom AS other
      WHERE other.element = a2.element
        AND other.molecule_id <> b.molecule_id
    )
  );

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
)
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b
  ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM connected AS c
      WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
         OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;

SELECT MAX(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND 1.0 * s.NumGE1500 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        COALESCE(s.School, sat.sname, s.District) AS School,
        s.District,
        s.County,
        sat.AvgScrWrite
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed'
      AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AvgScrWrite DESC) AS score_rank
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT School, District, County, AvgScrWrite
FROM ranked
WHERE score_rank = 2
ORDER BY School, District, County;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.code) AS count_sets
FROM sets AS s
JOIN set_translations AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age'
  AND t.language = 'Italian';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'
  AND power <> '*'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS official_ruling_count
FROM rulings
WHERE uuid IN (
    SELECT uuid
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Fireball'
);

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND frameVersion = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER))
      FROM cards
      WHERE frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
  )
  AND layout <> 'normal';

SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS printings
FROM foreign_data
WHERE language NOT IN ('Ancient Greek', 'Arabic', 'Hebrew', 'Latin', 'Sanskrit')
  AND (language <> 'Phyrexian' OR uuid IN (
      SELECT fd.uuid
      FROM foreign_data AS fd
      JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
      WHERE fd.language = 'Phyrexian'
        AND c.setCode = 'KHM'
  ))
GROUP BY language
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(printings)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS printings
        FROM foreign_data
        WHERE language NOT IN ('Ancient Greek', 'Arabic', 'Hebrew', 'Latin', 'Sanskrit')
          AND (language <> 'Phyrexian' OR uuid IN (
              SELECT fd.uuid
              FROM foreign_data AS fd
              JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
              WHERE fd.language = 'Phyrexian'
                AND c.setCode = 'KHM'
          ))
        GROUP BY language
    )
);

SELECT SUM(p.Score) AS total_score
FROM postLinks AS pl
JOIN posts AS target ON target.Id = pl.RelatedPostId
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = pl.PostId
WHERE target.Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  AND p.PostTypeId = 1
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%';

WITH target_posts AS (
    SELECT Id, Title
    FROM posts
    WHERE Title LIKE '%principal component scores%' COLLATE NOCASE
),
related_posts AS (
    SELECT PostId AS target_id, RelatedPostId AS related_id
    FROM postLinks
    UNION
    SELECT RelatedPostId AS target_id, PostId AS related_id
    FROM postLinks
),
counts AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Title, COUNT(DISTINCT r.related_id) AS related_count
    FROM target_posts AS p
    LEFT JOIN related_posts AS r
        ON r.target_id = p.Id
    GROUP BY p.Id, p.Title
)
SELECT Title, related_count
FROM counts
WHERE related_count = (SELECT MAX(related_count) FROM counts);

WITH player_appearances AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM "Match"
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM "Match"
),
country_counts AS (
    SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS player_match_count
    FROM player_appearances AS a
    JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_id
    JOIN Country AS c ON c.id = a.country_id
    WHERE p.weight <= 160
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT name, player_match_count
FROM country_counts
WHERE player_match_count = (SELECT MIN(player_match_count) FROM country_counts);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '');

WITH cohort_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) >= 1980 THEN 'young cohort'
            WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 1919 THEN 'old cohort'
        END AS cohort,
        a.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) >= 1980
       OR CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 1919
)
SELECT cohort, ROUND(AVG(d.A12)) AS average_salary
FROM cohort_districts cd
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = cd.district_id
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY CASE cohort WHEN 'young cohort' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM lapTimes AS l
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY MIN(l.milliseconds) ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, q.q1
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 = (
      SELECT MAX(q2.q1)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q1 IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_outqualified
FROM qualifying AS di_grassi
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = di_grassi.raceId
JOIN qualifying AS other_driver
  ON other_driver.raceId = di_grassi.raceId
 AND other_driver.position > di_grassi.position
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = di_grassi.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2010
  AND lower(d.forename) = 'lucas'
  AND lower(d.surname) = 'di grassi';

WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(b.spent, 0)) * 1.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(b.amount, 0)), 0) AS spending_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
SELECT event_name, spending_ratio
FROM event_ratios
WHERE spending_ratio = (
    SELECT MAX(spending_ratio)
    FROM event_ratios
);

SELECT
    a.department AS department_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.major_name) AS majors_offered,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.major_name END) AS majors_held,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(m.member_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.major_id), 2) AS average_members_per_major
FROM major AS a
LEFT JOIN member AS m
    ON m.link_to_major = a.major_id
WHERE a.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
GROUP BY a.department
ORDER BY a.department;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE b.category = 'Food'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY record_count DESC, item_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH dc_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superhero d ON d.id = hp.hero_id
    JOIN publisher p ON p.id = d.publisher_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
),
qualifying_marvel AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.height_cm
    FROM superhero m
    JOIN publisher p ON p.id = m.publisher_id
    JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = m.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND m.height_cm IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dc_powers d
          WHERE d.power_id = hp.power_id
      )
)
SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS average_height_cm
FROM qualifying_marvel;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad');

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND p.power_name = 'Flight'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg < 70;

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
      AND date(p.Birthday, '+56 years') <= date('2026-10-09')
      AND l.PT >= 14
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage_female
FROM cohort;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP = '+'
  AND p.Description IS NULL;

SELECT p.ID, l.Date, l.DNA
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> ''
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(l2.DNA AS REAL))
      FROM Laboratory AS l2
      WHERE l2.ID = p.ID
        AND l2.DNA IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(l2.DNA) <> ''
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;
SELECT 0.00 AS percentage;

SELECT e.Symptoms, p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC, p.ID ASC, e.`Examination Date` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CASE SEX
        WHEN 'M' THEN 'male'
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'female'
    END AS sex,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.GPT >= 60
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH molecule_saturation AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label,
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM bond b
                WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
                  AND b.bond_type <> '-'
            ) THEN 'other'
            ELSE 'all_single'
        END AS saturation_group
    FROM molecule AS m
)
SELECT
    saturation_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule_saturation
GROUP BY saturation_group
ORDER BY CASE saturation_group WHEN 'all_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;
